pages.text: Health 40, attack 5, movement speed 0.35.$(br)Fire immune. Spawns wearing a Serpon Helmet and Chestplate, with Serpon Leggings and a Serpon tail wrap at 50%% each; the main hand may hold a Serpon Sword, Serpon Blowpipe, Serpon Dagger or Serpon Pike, and the off hand may hold Arrows or a Serpon Spiked Shield.
Attacks at range while holding a pike / blowpipe; when holding a pike, it also melees enemies that get too close.
